what: Bus-side dispatch of the uplift DOMAINS to the cleanroom worker pool: a HOST coordinator hands a coverage-lift and a risky-test task to the VM worker over lbabus (bus-msg@1 CLAIM); the VM worker (provider=ollama) runs the full domain ON THE VM and returns the DONE receipt.

topology.worker: lba-ubuntu-scratch on VM lba-ubuntu2404-labview2026-scratch, worker pool --concurrency 2 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b
topology.provider: host Ollama reached from the VM at 10.0.2.2:11533 (TCP proxy)

dispatched.flow: coordinator CLAIM uplift:coverage-lift -> worker CLAIMED -> drove Ollama for a test -> measured V8 function coverage of the target ON THE VM -> DONE announced
coordinator CLAIM uplift:risky-test -> worker CLAIMED -> detected ffmpeg present -> drove Ollama for an ffmpeg test -> ran it -> DONE announced
dispatched.note: the gate has teeth: Ollama's proposed ffmpeg test failed (llama3.1:8b tends to write CommonJS require() in an ESM .mjs). The DISPATCH + tool detection + execution all worked; the provider's test was flawed.

note: The same bus-msg@1 CLAIM/ACK/DONE path was proven earlier for doc-draft; runDelegation dispatches all four domains, so the worker pool runs coverage-lift/risky-test/evidence unchanged. Comms-only: the provider drive + the domain acceptance ran on the VM; only the CLAIM/ACK/receipt crossed the bus.
